import sys
from collections import defaultdict

n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
scores = defaultdict(int)
max_score = 0
winner = ""

for _ in range(n):
    name, score = sys.stdin.readline().split()
    score = int(score)
    scores[name] += score
    if scores[name] > max_score:
        max_score = scores[name]
        winner = name
    elif scores[name] == max_score:
        if winner == "" or scores[winner] < max_score:
            winner = name

print(winner)
